paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Kuan inla, alawm in alunggulh tuntun numei, angkawmnu, pathian dangte lam nga in, grep beu gamte it mah le uh, TOUPA'N Israel suante a-it bang in it nawn in," ahon chi hi.
heading: Hosia Leh Gomer Kiten Nawnna
english: Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”

paite: Huchi in kei a ding in amah dangka shekel sawm-le-nga leh barli buh homer khat leh barli buh homer kimkhat in ka leita hi.
english: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.

paite: Akiang ah, "Kei a ding in ni tampi na om nilouh ding; kizuak in na om nawn kei dia, mi kuamah zi na hi kei ding; huchibang in kei leng nang lam ah ka om ding," ka chi hi.
english: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”

paite: Israel suante bel kumpi nei lou, vaihawmmi om lou, kithoihna nei lou, khuam siangthou lou, siampu puanak lou leh pathiante lou in ni tampi a-om nilouh ding uhi.
english: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.

paite: Huai nung chiang in Israel suante ahong kik nawn ding ua, TOUPA, a Pathian uh leh David akumpipa uh azong ding uhi; ni nanungte ah TOUPA kiang ah ahoihna zuan in lau kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
english: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to Yahweh and to his blessings in the last days.
